title: Settlement Agreement Information Database Act of 2026

summary: Settlement Agreement Information Database Act of 2026 This bill requires federal agencies to publish a searchable, online database of information about certain settlement agreements entered into by the agency. The database must include a copy of each settlement agreement, whether the agreement resolves a civil or criminal claim (or both), the date the agreement was executed, any alleged statutory violations, the amount of attorneys fees provided by or to the United States, any payment made to or by the federal government, the projected duration of the agreement, and any unit of government that is identified by the terms of the agreement.
